description: Bolan Castings Limited is a foundry producing grey and ductile iron castings for tractors and commercial vehicles. Incorporated in 1982 by Pakistan Automobile Corporation, it was privatised in 1993 to a group led by Millat Tractors Limited and the company's own employees, and is now a subsidiary of Millat Tractors. Its plant near Hub Chowki, Balochistan produces more than 16,000 tonnes a year of castings, with over 200 casting types developed.
headOffice: Main RCD Highway, Hub Chowki, District Lasbela, Balochistan
